about.title: A Brief History of Leelavati
about.editorialBoardDescription: The editorial board oversees the content and ensures that every article meets the magazine’s standards of quality and accuracy. They guide the magazine’s direction and support its vision.

forAuthors.scopeDescription: Leelavati publishes expository pieces, problem sets, historical essays etc. aimed at school students and teachers.

guidelines.resources: Problem sets and teacher resources are welcome.

forAuthors.latexIntro: We prefer submissions prepared in LaTeX. Please use the Leelavati style file to format your manuscript.
forAuthors.styNote: You may directly edit the sample English or Odia articles in the downloaded folder and compile them. All the required fonts have been included.
forAuthors.odiaTypeIntro: Below is a link to an online typing tool where you can type in Odia without installing any software.
forAuthors.submissionInstruction: Please send your article to leelavati.ocmse@gmail.com
